title: 2 Bedroom and Bathroom Honky Tonk Hideaway
description:
Centrally located 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner unit. 

Floor to ceiling windows and over 1200 sq feet with a balcony.

One assigned parking spot included with reservation! Early check-in available upon request and availability!

Walking distance from downtown bars and music row! With easy access from the airport you cannot beat this location. There is a fully stocked coffee bar and an Alexa to get the party started. You will have the stay of a lifetime in unit 423. Permit #2018072352.

The space
The apartment is located on the 4th floor of the Burnham on 5th Ave. It is just over 1200 sq feet with the ability to sleep 8 people comfortably with one king bed, two full beds, and a sofa bed. We have one queen, tall blow up mattress available as well for comfort. Our place is steps away from Bridgestone Arena, the Ryman Auditorium, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and a few blocks from Broadway. This is a perfect space for a group of friends or a family. The apartment complex acts as a hotel with a concierge (feel free to get packages delivered!), baggage check, on-site 24/7 maintenance, fire pits, roof-top lounge pool, gym, cabanas, and more. Our unit comes with a gated parking garage and access to 1 parking spot (lost garage door opener or permit is $150 fine).

We have tons of recommendations for things to do, restaurants, live-music venues, etc. so reach out to us if you have any questions at all on how to make your experience incredible.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire apartment as well as the private patio. Additionally, you will have access to the 2-story gym (with rock climbing wall!), pool, roof-top lounge, fire pits, BBQ area, etc. Our keyless entry using the Door App will allow you to take advantage of everything our space has to offer with ease for each of our guests. You will be given access to instructions prior to check-in.

Luggage check is available for guest use at a nominal cost pre and post checkin/out.

Other things to note
You will need to provide your email address for you and any guests in advance so we can add them to the Door app, you will need Bluetooth available on your phone to be able to use the Door app. We recommend downloading this application in advance of your stay. We have free wifi in our room as well as a smart TV.

If you are arriving in a car, you will need to park in the guest parking (there is a 20 minute grace period) and check in to the room. A designated parking spot is available. The permit and parking instructions are all in the unit.

We will accommodate early check-in or late check-out. We will let you know closer to the arrival date whether we can accommodate early or late checkout. Our place does have luggage drop off at any hour of the day for $5/bag.

If you have any other questions or concerns do not hesitate to contact us at any time, there are 3 of us co-hosting this unit so we will all be as responsive as possible to your needs, before, during, and after your stay.

Any check out past assigned time will receive a $100 per hour late check out fee. Any damages to any furniture or property will be billed at $500 per incidence. Any violation of our pet policy will be billed at $500 per incidence. The pull out couch, if damaged, will be charged $1500 to replace. Any excessive cleaning required by our cleaning crew will result in an extra $200 charge. Any violations of our policies or fines we receive due to violations of the complex rules will be passed onto the guest, this is a non smoking property and violations will be billed at $500 per instance. Guests cannot cancel/be refunded if pool is closed due to unforeseen circumstances. Please add all people to the reservation for pool access.
